question: Should default `openclaw doctor --lint` omit legacy state, skills readiness, session transcript, and session snapshot checks unless users pass `--all` or `--only`?
rationale: The implementation uses the existing internal selector cleanly, but only maintainers can accept changing the default diagnostics seen by existing automation and preflight users.

options.title: Accept Narrower Default Lint
options.body: Merge the current profile and document `--all` or `--only` as the supported path for these advisory or environment-sensitive diagnostics.

options.title: Keep Selected Checks Default
options.body: Ask the author to restore whichever of the four check families must remain part of default lint, with matching docs and focused assertions.

options.title: Pause For Broader Policy
options.body: Hold or close this PR if the default lint bar should be decided in a broader Doctor policy item instead of this focused audit.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrower Default Lint
recommendation.body: Merge the current profile and document `--all` or `--only` as the supported path for these advisory or environment-sensitive diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is product compatibility policy for a public Doctor default, and steipete has the strongest assignment/docs-policy routing signal among the likely owners.
